about: The asset provenance register (#2177): every picture, video, sound, font, mesh, texture, interface file and plugin Thornswood hands to people or shows them, with where it came from, who made it, the licence or permission it goes out under, the credit it asks for, who approved it and when, its sha256, and where it is published. Operator only: it lives in this private repository, no Ship, pack, installer or site deploy carries it, and tests\test-asset-provenance.js holds it to the files. A permission itself (an email, a message, a signed note) is never written here or in an issue: an entry says where it is kept. Program code and its licences are THIRD-PARTY.md's. Nothing here infers a right from a file's name, its history or its being online (#2177 Traps): what is not recorded says not recorded, and its ask names who can answer. Built 12 Oct 2026 from THIRD-PARTY.md, docs\WEBSITE-OPERATIONS.md, site\data\site\credits.md, records\ui-gone.json, scripts\release\Ship-Rules.ps1 and issues #1317, #1318, #1333, #1679 and #2298.

statuses.cleared: The licence is named by the file itself or its publisher and the evidence is cited, or the file holds nothing that could need one. Nothing to ask.
statuses.ours: Thornswood's own work: made for Thornswood by a team member under the contributor terms in LICENSE (#1331), or built here by a script in this repository from nothing but its own numbers. Who made it and who decided it are recorded. Nothing to ask.
statuses.derived: Built by a script in this repository from another entry (from). It goes out on that entry's terms, so it is settled when that one is.
statuses.unconfirmed: Made for Thornswood by this repository's own account, but who made it, on what terms, and who approved it are not recorded. Ships today. Its ask says what is missing and who can answer.
statuses.agreed-not-written: Patrick has said it may go out, but the terms with its maker are not written down anywhere. Ships today.
statuses.no-licence-found: Somebody else's, and nothing found gives Thornswood the right to hand it on. Ships today. Its issue carries the decision.
statuses.withheld: Never ships: packs and the installer leave it out and delete it from installs.
statuses.made-from-game: Bethesda's own file, edited, or put together from Bethesda's: it never ships. The launcher, and Go.ps1, make it on each machine from that machine's own game archives (#2827), so nobody is handed the game's files. Its record is the Ship-Rules.ps1 list that keeps it out of every pack and the installer. Nothing to ask.
statuses.not-published: In this private repository only; nobody outside the team receives it.

assets.what: Thornswood's own plugin, 110,915 bytes on 17 Oct (#2553). Every record in it is written by scripts/mods/Add-ContentRecords.py from its own numbers, or is Bethesda's own record it overrides: the cells and the worldspace its placements stand in, copied from the winning master, and the house part and woodworking recipe overrides. Its placements of the kiln, the salt quarry, the hive and the alchemy lab stand where scripts/dev/Build-StationSites.py measured Thornswood's own spots (game/data/station-sites.json). Until #400 its header said its crafting and gathering content was salvaged from another server's plugin; scripts/mods/content-salvaged.json lists every salvaged record and that none is left.

dispositions.how: Each submission is checked by staff for permission and privacy before it is approved; submitting is not proof of ownership of somebody else's material (Terms; docs\WEBSITE-OPERATIONS.md, Asset permission evidence). They are people's data on the VPS, so they are not listed here one by one. A removed submission's file is #2352.

Thornswood does not hand them on: each person installs them from Nexus Mods through Vortex under each author's own terms, and the launcher and the public credits page link every one (THIRD-PARTY.md, Not shipped by Thornswood). What packs used to carry of them is THIRD-PARTY.md's entry 168 paragraph.
